title: Training vs Kewl Tune
summary: Kewl Tune is a compact Tuner Synchro engine. Mix or Reco searches Rotary; Rotary reveals a Tuner to Normal Summon extra, then they Synchro Track Maker into Remix/RS. Rotary looking at your hand is the format's defining piece of information.
winConditions: Stop Rotary from resolving so they never see your hand
Break Remix before the opponent's turn follow-up Synchro
Win through a thin endboard (Remix + one utility Synchro) before they convert GY Tuners
keyCardsRespect: Kewl Tune Rotary — extra Normal Summon and look at hand
Kewl Tune Mix / Reco — search the engine
Kewl Tune Synchro — search plus a Synchro Summon
Kewl Tune Remix — opponent-turn tribute into another Synchro
Kewl Tune RS — Quick Effect negate
Zalen the Shackled Dragon — chain-on-chain negate
keyCardsNegate: Mix/Reco on-summon search if it finds Rotary

tips.title: Ash the search, not every Tuner
tips.body: Any Kewl Tune name can start, but Rotary is the card that turns a line into full information. Hold Ash for Mix/Reco/Synchro when it would find Rotary, or for Track Maker if Rotary already resolved.

tips.title: Remix is the grind
tips.body: If they end on Remix, they will tribute it on your turn, revive two Tuners, and Synchro again. Play like they still have a full extra summon on your turn.

tips.title: They are all Tuners
tips.body: Nibiru, Droll, and floodgates that hate Special Summons of Tuners are better than random monster negates after the board is already Remix + Zalen.

handtrapGuidance: Ash Mix, Reco, or Kewl Tune Synchro when it searches Rotary.
Imperm Rotary on field before they Synchro it for the GY look-at-hand.
Droll after the first search if they still have Synchro/Track Maker.
Nibiru if they keep Synchro summoning without a negate up.
commonMistakes: Ashing a random Tuner Normal Summon and letting Rotary resolve
Playing as if Remix is a vanilla 1500 body
Committing your only breaker into Zalen's chain-negate
